newsitem.title: USA: Miller, shareholders to sell 3.4 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Miller, shareholders to sell 3.4 mln shrs.

text.p: Miller Industries Inc said Tuesday it filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 3,365,685 common shares along with its shareholders including William Miller, chairman of the board.
Of the total amount, the company is offering one million shares for sale while certain stockholders are selling 2,365,685 common shares, the filing said.
After the offering, there will be 25,051,364 common shares outstanding.
Miller, 49, also the company's chief executive officer is offering up to two million shares. The balance of the shares are for sale by other shareholders.
Net proceeds will be used to fund capital expenditures, finance future acquitisions and for general corporate purposes, the filing said.

The underwriters have been granted an over-allotment option of up to 504,852 additional shares. The offering will be made through Bear Stearns & Co Inc, J.C. Bradford & Co, Montgomery Securities and The Robinson-Humphrey Company Inc.
The Atlanta, Ga-based company manufactures vehicle towing and recovery equipment in North America and Europe.
